fixtureDigestScope: UTF-8 bytes of the fixtures array serialized as recursively key-sorted compact JSON with no trailing newline
profileDigestScope: UTF-8 bytes of the complete top-level profile object with only profileDigest omitted, serialized as recursively key-sorted compact JSON with no trailing newline

contractBindings.digestScope: Exact UTF-8 file bytes as committed, including LF line endings and the final newline

generatedMapper.source: The generated digest-pinned BFF-to-core mapper for the two bound contracts
generatedMapper.digestScope: Exact emitted mapper artifact bytes as used by the performance runner
generatedMapper.verification: CI regenerates the mapper from the two digest-matched contracts, rejects committed or runtime drift before warm-up, and records the used mapper artifact digest in every measured observation.

execution.concurrencyRule: All ten workers wait at a barrier before each measured ordinal, then each issues exactly one request and waits for it to finish before the next barrier.
execution.coreMappingRule: Validate each camelCase fixture against its fixtureOperationId, map it only through the generated digest-pinned BFF-to-core mapper, validate the snake_case result against coreOperationId, then invoke core ASGI directly. Mapping and BFF transport occur before timingStart and are excluded from core duration; any validation or mapping failure fails the profile before warm-up.
execution.fixtureAssignment: Filter fixtures by the active scenario, sort that three-fixture list by caseId, then select scenarioFixtures[(workerIndex + requestOrdinal) mod 3] with zero-based worker and request ordinals. Warm-up ordinals are 0-1; measured ordinals reset to 0-9.
execution.warmupFailurePolicy: Both declared warm-up requests per worker must succeed within the scenario timeout. Any failure aborts the profile as failed; it cannot be replaced or excluded.
execution.timeoutPolicy: Cancel at the exact scenario timeout. A timeout or any non-success response remains one of the 100 measured attempts, is a threshold failure, retains its raw outcome, and contributes the scenario timeout value to nearest-rank p95 rather than disappearing from the sample.
execution.timingStart: Core ASGI request entry read from a monotonic clock.
execution.timingStop: Completion of response serialization read from the same monotonic clock.
execution.percentile: nearest-rank p95 over all 100 measured values; rank=ceil(0.95*100)=95 after ascending sort
